_readme: Single source of truth for the site's brand. Edit this file, then run
`node scripts/apply-brand.mjs` (the brand.yml workflow does it automatically
on push) to stamp every page, API function and OG image.
`_applied` is machine-managed bookkeeping — the script rewrites it; don't edit.

loreHtml: Suit on. Bag packed. Buy button off.

Straight out of the r/wallstreetbets GME saga — the friendly free-trading app that turned off the buy button, sold the order flow and walked off with the hood's bag. Robbinghood is the getaway car, immortalized on-chain: the robbery becomes the ticker.
$ROBBINGHOOD is the ticker. He's got the bag. The buy button is disabled.
